title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty German-inspired beef stew made with tender beef shin, vegetables, and aromatic spices. Perfect for a cold winter night.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrot and potato to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef broth, red wine (if using), thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
